resources.assets:6452.name: E Weakling
resources.assets:6452.description: Peasants equipped with clubs. Not an enemy to worry about, unless they appear in bigger numbers.

resources.assets:6459.name: E Racer
resources.assets:6459.description: Racers are fast rolling monsters that are not messing around. They aim right for your castle center and are somewhat armored against attacks from the player character.

resources.assets:6458.name: E Hunterling
resources.assets:6458.description: Hunterlings are incredibly fast and dangerous monsters with the sole aim of chasing you down. They can smell your royal blood all across the entire kingdom.

resources.assets:6451.name: E Ogre
resources.assets:6451.description: Ogres are huge melee warriors that really pack a punch. Hey! Due to their human heritage, ogres aren't monsters though (everybody knows that, duh).

resources.assets:5073.name: E Fury
resources.assets:5073.description: A large flying monster that focusses on destroying your defenses. Their projectiles are quite slow and easy to dodge but wreak havoc when they hit.

resources.assets:5076.name: E Catapult
resources.assets:5076.description: Catapults are siege units that deal massive damage to your buildings from afar. Your only chance is to get close and destroy them before they demolish your walls.

resources.assets:6473.name: E LongSpear
resources.assets:6473.description: Equipped with long spears. Your horse is slowed and you take additional damage when riding into them, even more so when galloping. Better try to stay out of their range.

resources.assets:5072.name: E Ram
resources.assets:5072.description: Rams are siege units with a ton of health looking to tear down your walls and buildings. Furthermore, they are armored against ranged attacks.
